units.title: General Principles of Law of Contract-I:
units.topics: 1.1 Nature of Contract: Object of the law of contract, The Indian Contract Act, 1872, Definition of Contract, Essential Elements of a Valid Contract, Classification of Contracts, Classification of Contracts in English Law 1.2 Offer and Acceptance: Meaning and Kinds of Offer, Legal Rules as to Offer, Meaning of Acceptance, Legal Rules as to Acceptance, Communication of Offer and Acceptance 1.3 Consideration: Definition of Consideration, Need for Consideration, Legal Rules as to Consideration, Stranger to Contract, A Contract without Consideration is Void-Exceptions 1.4 Capacity of Contract: Minor, Persons of Unsound Mind and Other Persons 1.5 Free Consent: Meaning of Consent and Free Consent, Coercion, Undue influence, Misrepresentation, Fraud, Mistake 1.6 Legality of Object: Unlawful of Consideration or Object, Unlawful and Illegal Agreements, Agreements opposed to Public Policy
